entities.summary: Joseph McNaull is an American former professional basketball player who also has Polish citizenship. Born in Miami, Florida, he is 6'10" and played at center. Represented Polish national basketball team for Eurobasket qualification. With Śląsk Wrocław he won four consecutive Polish league titles. With Norrköping Dolphins he won a Swedish league title in 2010.
